sources.title: BERT (language model) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Bidirectional encoder representations from transformers (BERT) is a language model introduced in October 2018 by researchers at Google. [2][3] It learns to represent text as a sequence of vectors using self-supervised learning.

sources.title: MeLLL - Machine Learning & Language Learning Research Group
sources.snippet: The Machine Learning & Language Learning (MeLLL) research group is a premier research group dedicated to pushing the boundaries of artificial intelligence. Our interdisciplinary team combines expertise in machine learning and computational linguistics to develop innovative solutions for understanding and processing human language.
